description: You can link a Minecraft Java Edition account to your Discord user, so that Minecraft commands that take a username can default to your own account. Once linked, you can run commands like <command:skin|minecraftskins skin> without providing a username at all.
The link is tied to your Discord user rather than to a server, so it works everywhere, including in DMs.

data.title: Minecraft account
footer: Disclaimer: Wynem does not verify account ownership

description.text: Where the linked account is used

description: The following commands all use your linked account when you leave the username out:

rows: View the skin of a Minecraft Java edition player
View the head of a Minecraft Java edition player
View the cape and elytra of a Minecraft Java edition player
Apply an outfit to a Minecraft skin
Make one Minecraft player kick another Minecraft player!

description: You can also pass a member's @mention in place of a username in these commands, to use their linked account instead of your own.

tabs.name: Linking an account
content: To link a Minecraft account, use the <command:setminecraftaccount [username]|minecraft setaccount minecraft-username:[username]> command.
The username is looked up against Mojang's account database, so it must belong to a real Java Edition account. Linking a new account replaces the previous one.

tabs.name: Viewing an account
content: To view the Minecraft account linked to someone's Discord, use the <command:minecraftaccount [member]|minecraft account member:[member]> command. Leave out the member to view your own account.

data.title: Minecraft account
footer: Disclaimer: Wynem does not verify account ownership

content: The embed title links to the account's [NameMC](https://namemc.com/) profile.
If the member hasn't linked an account, you will be told, along with how they can set one.

tabs.name: Unlinking an account
content: To remove your linked account, run the <command:setminecraftaccount|minecraft setaccount> command without a username.

data.title: Account removed
data.description: `EwanHowell` is no longer set as your Minecraft account

content: If you run the command without a username while no account is linked, you will instead be asked to provide a username to set.
